Yinyang appendicesOriginal edition

Yinyang package maintenance

Use MODEL.md for the package's source roles, interpretive boundaries, and maintenance method. The core views state the numbered claims; essays develop their arguments. Read the affected source and its dependencies rather than reproducing the full philosophy in every file.

The user-facing work should be readable both within each piece and across the collection. Existing wording, section order, and examples are revisable. Preserve the relations that carry the argument, useful source attribution, and actual consumer contracts; remove repetition and obsolete scaffolding.

Authored and situated sources

SKILL.md owns invocation. Philosophy and models connects philosophical expression and models. The six writing guides under references/formation/, including how to revise, own their actual directions. Environmental realization belongs to the environment guide; revision guidance belongs to the revision guide. The package guide owns common/situated structure and projection. Refer to these owners where a document needs their method instead of restating it.

Distributed and situated editions share common content, including six public how-to guides under references/formation/. A private situated package adds six actual files at references/situated/{orientation,person,counterpart,relationship,environment,revision}.md. The actual revision method is authored for that person and environment; a common guide cannot replace it. Ordinary use reads all six actual files in full. The six files are personal working models of person–model cooperation, intended to make the actual personal environment fit the person psychologically and practically. Psychological and life evidence and maintained interpretations principally belong in references/personal/, with originals retained at their existing owners; references/personal/sources.md is its question-selected entrance. person.md selects working implications rather than a whole psychological portrait. Follow the maintenance method for every refresh of the six working files; do not duplicate its protocol here. Public distribution contains neither private tree. scripts/sync-common.py preserves both trees. Do not retrieve private portraits merely to maintain this public package. Other authors can change the organization and philosophy; maintenance preserves this six-guide/six-actual contract.

Edition and publication coherence

Keep complete English and Chinese reader editions aligned; model-facing maintenance prose is English. Preserve existing YY identifiers as references to their claims. Repair links when changing titles, paths, or anchors.

Diagram candidate JSON owns the authored relationships. Regenerate HTML/SVG and inspect the resulting relationships and readability when a diagram changes. Website and plugin copies are projections; edit their actual source owner. The public package owns the philosophical essays and practical guide; the native Site owns their presentation.

Preserve licenses, third-party notices, and public/private boundaries under MODEL.md and LICENSE. The philosophy is a usable example: recipients may adopt, combine, challenge, or author a different work.
